comparison.objective: Seat a bracket bolt using repeated short ratchet strokes in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Acquire a socket, maintain engagement, ratchet through drive/return cycles, and control seating torque/contact.
comparison.success_condition: Required bolt advance, bracket seating contact, at least six ratchet cycles, and no integrity or torque fault.
comparison.reason: It shares socket engagement and bounded torque, but tests confined ratcheting of a threaded fastener, not relocating a collar-mounted socket and tuning a damper from measured carriage response. Early versions note an unqualified live scorer, while later versions provide explicit contact criteria.
